title: 探头笑
editing_notes: 为保持闭眼笑，重画中段的倾头姿势，并剪去回中时三张睁眼候选帧。

strip-0.prompt:
Act as a senior 2D inbetween animator. Return a continuous production sheet in EXACTLY the same layout as this reference: THREE columns, FOUR rows, TWELVE equally sized complete square images, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Fill every square with one fully drawn camera-locked scene. Its white background, screen coordinates, character scale, clothing and props agree with the reference. No grids, numbering, words, motion trails, crossfades or double hands. The attached four rows give A, B, B, C. Create TWO successive micro-actions: top TWO rows are SIX evenly spaced DIFFERENT complete inbetween poses from the first reference A toward B, bottom TWO rows are SIX from B toward C. The six progress values in EACH block are about 10%,26%,42%,58%,74%,90%. Source extremes are supplied separately in the final GIF, so fill ALL cells with precision motion, never six identical drawings. Follow bright clean line art and maintain exact registration and hand identity; no autonomous camera shake. Full story for context: Nailü white battle V3, pearl headband, large head bow and white gloves. Both gloved hands below chin. Close eyes, smile and lean left, briefly center, peek right, return to center smiling. Hair bow always same side; hands follow shoulders.
A = 0.0 s: Draw Nailü nearly centered, beginning a slight screen-left lean, eyes closed and smiling, both white-gloved hands visible below her chin.
B = 0.5 s: Draw her leaning farther screen-left with closed eyes and a broad smile, both hands following her shoulders below her chin.
C = 1.0 s: Draw her at the deepest screen-left lean, eyes closed and cheeks lifted, both hands clearly separated below her chin.
Trust the actual illustrated poses in the attachment for the shape, timing and exact action. Preserve figure count and source costume. Never place hands, limbs or extra flowers into adjacent cells.
